text: The brands on Jeonbuk Hyundai's 2026 kit are Hyundai Motor Group's own: NEXO is Hyundai Motor's hydrogen electric car and the front sponsor since 2025, HTWO is Hyundai Motor Group's hydrogen business brand, and Mobility robot MobED with the Robotics Lab mark is Hyundai Motor Group Robotics Lab's platform. Hyundai Motor is the club's parent company ('모기업 현대자동차').
short: The Hyundai brands on Jeonbuk's shirt (NEXO, HTWO, MobED/Robotics Lab) belong to Hyundai Motor Group, the club's parent.

source.name: 전북일보 (Jeonbuk Ilbo): 전북현대, 새 시즌 유니폼 공개…메인 스폰서 'NEXO(넥쏘)'로 교체 [Jeonbuk unveils new kit, front sponsor changes to NEXO]
source.quote: 올 시즌 유니폼 전면에는 글로벌 수소전기차 시장을 선도하는 현대자동차의 수소전기차 'NEXO(넥쏘)'가 자리 잡았다
source.note: The article also names Hyundai Motor as the club's parent company ('모기업 현대자동차') and says HTWO, '현대자동차그룹의 수소 사업 브랜드' Hyundai Motor Group's hydrogen business brand, is on the right sleeve (2025 season).

additionalSources.name: 전북일보 (Jeonbuk Ilbo): 전북현대 유니폼 '빼곡'⋯로보틱스랩 모베드 파트너십 체결 [Jeonbuk signs Robotics Lab/MobED partnership]
additionalSources.quote: 모베드는 현대차그룹 로보틱스랩이 개발한 소형 모빌리티 로봇 플랫폼이다
additionalSources.note: MobED is a small mobility robot platform developed by Hyundai Motor Group Robotics Lab; the article confirms HTWO continues as a 2026 uniform partner.
